difficulty_reason: Lift a fiber basis to a surjection from a free module. Reducedness lets a nonzero relation coefficient be invertible somewhere, where that relation contradicts the prescribed number of fiber generators. The author prints the full contradiction.

dedup.scope: These give the Fitting-locus functor, the torsion-free criterion on a regular integral curve, and surjections between locally free modules of equal rank. This criterion assumes finite type and constant rank over a reduced base.
